messages:
sasha: Heads-up — main pipeline went red immediately after the merge of PR #6321. Integration-tests stage hit a hard timeout. Run: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/45678
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline=main stage=integration-tests status=FAILED reason=timeout duration=1800s run=45678
kevin: On it, grabbing logs. Which specific job timed out?
sasha: integration-tests/kv-cache-e2e (step 12). The step log shows it hanging on a `wait_for_eviction()` call.
marta: If it's that kv eviction hang again, we can rerun just that job: `ci rerun --job integration-tests/kv-cache-e2e --run 45678`. I'll kick one off now.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by marta for job=integration-tests/kv-cache-e2e new_run=45679
darren: Starting a bisect over the 7 commits that merged in that batch. Will report back if any failure reproduces.
kevin: Looking at the logs — process stuck on epoll for ~10m, no OOM, no obvious exceptions. Could be a flake in the eviction test or a kernel-level scheduling blip.
sasha: Good catch. If rerun is green we can treat as transient; if it flakes twice in a row we should consider reverting #6321. @darren how long for bisect?
darren: Bisect job queued; should finish in ~12–15m depending on cluster load. If the rerun fails, I'll prioritize.
ci-bot: Rerun completed: run=45679 job=integration-tests/kv-cache-e2e status=PASS duration=1200s
kevin: Rerun came back green. Marking this as likely transient. I'll keep an eye for a second failure.
sasha: Thanks all. I'll clear the pager and monitor for 10m, then close the incident if nothing else pops. :ok_hand:
